recipes.oracle_text:
{1}{R}{R}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
{T}, Remove all +1/+1 counters from this creature: It deals damage to any target equal to the number of +1/+1 counters removed this way.

recipe_coverage: Whole-Oracle ordinary persistent growth: actual source casting, printed activation costs, source/target-independent self growth, source loss, explicit bounced-source counter clearing, repeated growth, cleanup and pending replay. Every actual activation has a fresh or already-tapped source, disabling its independent tap-to-damage mode; that elective mode remains an explicit component gap. Human single-choice auto-selection and presented AI input are pinned independently of Oracle expectations. Authoritative native/Wasm validation is recorded in the wave5 report.
